contract.visual_selection: predeclared case 0 within every distance shell
contract.stopping_rule: first exact goal hit, native death, or the 24-action limit
contract.uncertainty: Wilson 95% intervals separately per checkpoint and distance; no pooled interval
contract.rgb_source: exact keyed simulator re-rendering of recorded executions; unchanged uint8 RGB
contract.prior_primary: original 6-12-action hard-goal evaluation remains unchanged and separately reported
contract.independent_audit: JSON report with top-level status, verdict, or overall equal to PASS

figures.caption: Post-outcome operating-range diagnostic of the unchanged frozen visual-goal controllers, conducted after the unsuccessful 6–12-action hard-goal primary. All six goal-distance shells and all three existing model seeds were admitted before the follow-up. Every point is exact goal hits out of 128 starts before native death or the 24-action limit; whiskers are Wilson 95% intervals for that model and shell only. The same 128 valid prefixes are reused across shells, so neither shells nor model-seed results are pooled into an IID binomial interval. JEPA receives RGB history, outgoing actions and an RGB goal. The H1/H3 controllers retain exhaustive latent-distance search and the H3 summed stage cost; the state oracle uses privileged physical coordinates. The follow-up changes goal distance only and does not replace the original harder-goal result or establish long-horizon planning.

All six predeclared visual examples: within-shell case 0, with the same valid RGB prefix and a different sampled goal at each initial distance. Paths are actual recorded positions, truncated at first exact goal hit, native death, or the action limit. Coordinates are diagnostic overlays on a faded initial RGB frame, not JEPA inputs. The state oracle is privileged. A dashed square marks the goal; endpoint circle denotes a hit, cross another ending. This follow-up was designed after the failed original hard-goal primary and is labeled post-outcome.
figures.rgb_transform: alpha .24 in labeled path diagrams only

figures.caption: JEPA H3 observed trajectories for every predeclared visual shell: the same within-shell case 0, at goals one, two, three, six, nine and twelve moves away. Images are exact keyed simulator re-renderings of the saved executions, with RGB values unchanged. The first-shell replay is bit-for-bit checked against directly recorded RGB by the evaluator and renderer. Frames occur every four actions plus the exact terminal frame; no padding after first goal hit or death is displayed. Labels show the action entering each sampled frame and the full executed action sequence. All six shells are retained independently of whether JEPA succeeds. This is a post-outcome diagnostic, not a replacement for the original harder-goal primary.
